blockers.detail: oniguruma moved from modules/ to vendor/ by 9727721; harness link line still references ./modules/oniguruma/src/.libs/libonig.a

rationale.zh: 本次提交只修改 jv.c 的一元取负数值精度，属于 jq_fuzz_execute 可达的代码。但早在 9727721（把 oniguruma 与 decNumber 移入 vendor/）时，harness 的构建配置仍链接 ./modules/oniguruma/src/.libs/libonig.a，从那以后所有 fuzz 目标都无法链接。这次变更没有修复该问题，harness 在变更前后都无法构建，属于非本次引入的显式 configuration 退化；维护者在 oss-fuzz 489ed2798 中改为 vendor/ 路径。
rationale.en: This commit only changes unary-negation precision in jv.c, which jq_fuzz_execute reaches. But since 9727721 (oniguruma and decNumber moved to vendor/), the harness build configuration still links ./modules/oniguruma/src/.libs/libonig.a, so every fuzz target fails to link. This change does not repair that: the harness is unbuildable before and after it. Pre-existing explicit configuration degradation; fixed in oss-fuzz 489ed2798 (vendor/ paths).
